preconditions.description: The length of the string `s` must be equal to the length of the `indices` array.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] == return_value[indices[i]] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the string `s` must be placed in the output string `return_value` at the position specified by the corresponding index in the `indices` array.
